name: AI Review
description: CI-friendly AI code review tool that posts inline, summary or context-aware reviews across the major git hosting platforms.
whatItDoes: AI Review runs in a pipeline and comments on pull or merge requests. It can leave line-level remarks, an overall summary, or a review informed by wider context. It supports GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket Cloud and Server, Azure DevOps and Gitea.
howItWorks: The CLI collects the diff from the hosting platform, sends it to the configured model with the project's prompts, and publishes the results through the platform API. It ships as a Python package and a Docker image for CI use.

requirements.name: LLM provider credentials
requirements.description: Key or endpoint for the chosen model provider

requirements.name: Git platform token
requirements.description: Lets the tool read the change and post comments

models: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, Bedrock, OpenRouter, Azure OpenAI
